institutions.description: My current journey in the heart of Kamuning, Quezon City! Pursuing higher education in a college like CIIT is certainly one of the plot twists of my life. I am excited to further my journey in this institution, make new friends, and learn a lot of new things from the very best around me.

The most transformative 2 years of my life. This is where I really learned what it means to excel beyond the classroom and grow as a leader. My time here in DLSU-D will always be remembered as a time of growth for me as I certainly will not be who I am today without the experiences and lessons I gained from this institution.
